attempts.text:
**The window starts at `osmC`.** Column 0 is the only spine: `osmC` is carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, and in a region of plasticity in 2% of calls. The model names it in 98% of genomes, with 0.22 bits.

**Then 79 fork and variable columns open**, in a region of plasticity in 6 to 89% of calls. The model names 88% of genes on average, fewest at column 22, `yncH`, named 63%, and hesitates most at column 21, `ydcD`, 2.04 bits, in a region of plasticity in 87% of calls. The 20 columns most in regions of plasticity are named in 78% of calls at 1.01 bits; the other 60, 91% at 0.44 bits.

**A first branch runs through columns 1 to 23**, 23 families from `ddpF` to `ydeS`, carried by 12 to 15% of chromosomes, 17 shell and 6 persistent. Further branches sit at columns 33 to 36, `lsrB` to `tam`, at columns 41 to 46, `glsB` to `marC`, and at columns 58 to 61, `mgtS` to `ydeI`. The forks carry `fdnI` to `narI`, [[formate and nitrate oxidoreduction]], and `hicB`, `hicA`, [[toxin-antitoxin mRNA interference]].

**Variable stretches follow**, `pqqU` and `mcbR`, then `yneE` at 14%, `marR` at 15%, and columns 51 to 55, `rimL` to `ydcI`, at 81 to 82%. Columns 67 to 71, `ynbC` to `pdxI`, are shell, 44 to 67%. The window ends at column 79, `paaI`, in 35% of chromosomes, after the `paaY` to `paaI` fork, [[phenylacetic acid degradation]].

**Inside a region of plasticity the model hesitates more than outside**, 1.31 against 0.30 bits, and names fewer genes, 72% against 94%; 11,956 of 42,880 calls are inside one. Persistent calls are named 96% at 0.23 bits, shell 77% at 1.04 bits, cloud 11% at 4.41 bits.

label: osmC
facts:
WINDOW: the osmC window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor osmC, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,242 to 2,321 from dnaA. Read in 536 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying osmC once); 42,880 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 88% of genes, 0.58 bits on average (perplexity 1.8 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 26,509 calls, named 96%, 0.23 bits; shell 15,794 calls, named 77%, 1.04 bits; cloud 577 calls, named 11%, 4.41 bits. Outside an RGP 30,924 calls, named 94%, 0.30 bits; inside an RGP 11,956 calls, named 72%, 1.31 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 59 fork, 20 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.31 against 0.30 bits) and names fewer genes (72% against 94%); 11,956 of the 42,880 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 21 (ydcD) 2.04 bits, RGP 87%; column 22 (yncH) 1.78 bits, RGP 89%; column 20 ("hypothetical protein") 1.62 bits, RGP 74%. The 20 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 78%, 1.01 bits on average; the other 60 columns: named 91%, 0.44 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 1-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 6-89%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 2%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 2%. Genes: osmC. named 98%; 0.22 bits.
2. columns 1-79 (79 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 6-89%. named 63-99% (mean 88%), fewest named at column 22, named 63%; most hesitant at column 21, 2.04 bits.
   a second branch of 23 families through columns 1-23, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 12-15%, 17 S, 6 P; the branch's families: ddpF, ddpD, ddpC, ddpB, ddpA, ddpX, dosP, dosC, digH, gadC, gadB, pqqL, yddB, yddA, "hypothetical protein", ydeM, ydeN, ydeO, safA, ydeP, ydeQ, ydeR, ydeS
   a second branch of 4 families through columns 33-36, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 13-14%, 3 S, 1 P; the branch's families: lsrB, lsrF, lsrG, tam
   a second branch of 6 families through columns 41-46, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 10-15%, 5 P, 1 S; the branch's families: glsB, sad, ptrR, yneK, ydeA, marC
   a second branch of 4 families through columns 58-61, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 13-14%, 3 P, 1 S; the branch's families: mgtS, mgtT, dgcZ, ydeI
